description: The file defines API routes for managing estimates and estimate items, including CRUD operations, listing, and recalculating totals, using FastAPI framework and SQLAlchemy ORM models.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object used to define API endpoints.

methods.name: Estimate _get_estimate_or_404(db: Session, estimate_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an Estimate by ID or raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: EstimateItem _get_item_or_404(db: Session, item_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an EstimateItem by ID or raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: List[Estimate] list_estimates(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Lists all estimates with nested items.

methods.name: Estimate create_estimate(payload: EstimateCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
Estimate get_estimate(estimate_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches an estimate by its ID.

methods.name: Estimate update_estimate( estimate_id: int, payload: EstimateUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing estimate.

methods.name: None delete_estimate(estimate_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes an estimate and its items.

methods.name: List[EstimateItem] list_items(estimate_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Lists all items belonging to a specific estimate.

methods.name: EstimateItem create_item( estimate_id: int, payload: EstimateItemCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Creates a new estimate item under a specific estimate.

methods.name: EstimateItem get_item(item_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches an estimate item by its ID.

methods.name: EstimateItem update_item(item_id: int, payload: EstimateItemUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Updates fields of an estimate item.

methods.name: None delete_item(item_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes an estimate item by its ID.

methods.name: Dict recalc_totals(estimate_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Recalculates totals and breakdown for an estimate.
